program.section_heading: Religious Studies Associate in Arts Degree
program.ge_pattern: Cypress College Local General Education or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)
outcomes: Compare, contrast, and assess at least two methodological approaches utilized in the academic study of religion, including the methods and theories of religious studies scholarship, in order to cultivate an objective understanding of the world's religious traditions.

Compare and contrast at least two of the major religious traditions, focusing on an ethical aspect and on an aspect of practice, in order to demonstrate the ability to synthesize knowledge of world religious traditions.

Identify, explain, and evaluate at least two aspects of the worldviews held by two of the major Asian traditions through critical analysis of topics introduced in courses, in order to cultivate objective knowledge of diverse Asian religious traditions.

Identify and evaluate at least two major theological issues dividing Protestantism, Roman Catholicism, and Eastern Orthodoxy in order to reflect on the historical, social, and cultural contexts out of which the global diversity of Christianity emerges.
